bootstrap.unit: two-way paired over seeds x families

H1_m4_replication.rule: M4 gate v2 pass rule, unchanged (95% intervals).

H2_partial_retained_vs_freeze.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9: lower bound > 0.

H3_partial_retained_vs_pause.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9: lower bound > 0.
H3_partial_retained_vs_pause.note: Pause never isolates an agent under partition3/random50, so pause equals standard there by construction; this is the same contrast as retained vs standard in that regime and is not independent evidence.

H4a_total_retained_vs_freeze_equivalence.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 entirely inside (-0.02, +0.02).

H4b_total_retained_vs_pause_equivalence.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 entirely inside (-0.02, +0.02).

H5a_final_disagreement_vs_standard.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 of (standard - retained) D20: lower bound > 0.

H5b_final_disagreement_vs_freeze_noninfe.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 of (freeze - retained) D20: lower bound > -0.01 (retained at most 1 pp above).

H5c_final_disagreement_vs_pause_noninfer.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 of (pause - retained) D20: lower bound > -0.01.

H6a_post_reconnection_disagreement_vs_st.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 of (standard - retained): lower bound > 0.

H6b_post_reconnection_disagreement_vs_fr.rule: Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided percentile interval, level 1-0.05/9 of (freeze - retained): lower bound > 0.

caveat: Intervals are conditional on the three fixed initializations (resampling 3 seeds yields only 10 distinct multisets); Sudoku only; no physical robotics claim; hypotheses H2-H6 were formulated from post-hoc M4 observations, which is why they are tested on unseen families.
